title: Work Experience
intro: Professional software engineering experience delivering and maintaining digital systems for Sri Lanka's Department of Agrarian Development.

items.title: Software Engineer
items.description: Design, develop, and maintain software applications supporting the Department's operational and digital-service requirements while continuing to enhance existing departmental systems.
achievements: Independently developed and currently maintain DAD TV, an internal broadcasting and media-management platform used by the Department.
Maintain and expand the FarmerNet web platform, including the ongoing development of its next version.

items.title: Software Engineer
items.description: Contributed to the design and fully developed Version 1 modules of the FarmerNet Web Platform.
achievements: Delivered farmer registration and authentication, profile management, land registration, cultivation management, damage reporting, harvesting records, and officer-side data management.
Conducted application and database testing and optimization while supporting deployment and server administration using Linux, Red Hat OpenShift, Docker, Podman, Nginx, SSH, Git, and GitHub.
